{{Quote|Hr=SS
|A flea alone is good, but fleas together is best!
|Vog}}

<b>Vog</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She sells map pins showing the location of lost [[Flea]]s at the [[Flea Caravan]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
<b>Vog</b> is a hunter of [[Flea]] tribe, a rare sort valued by the rest of the Fleas for the protection they provide, despite their gruff demeanour.<ref>[[Fleamaster Mooshka]]: <i>"Miss Hornet, I must tell, we've seen evidence nearby of a hunter of our tribe, a flea that seeks fleas! As pungent and gruff as their sort often are, they're still useful to have around a caravan. A flea of their rare skill, settled among us, could offer defence and more."</i></ref><ref>[[Fleamaster Mooshka]]: <i>"Her scent may be strong, and her taste for brew bottomless, but her skill is sharp. If predators draw close, her talents will provide much confidence to our caravan."</i></ref> For a long time, she tracked lost [[Flea]]s throughout [[Pharloom]], and after she sensed the location of all of them, she decided to find and join a caravan.<ref name = gender/><ref>Vog: <i>"You remain, bug not flea? Would you seek service of me, ehh? Mine is knowledge much, the places of the lost little ones, heard and smelt across the caves"</i></ref><ref>Vog: <i>"Task? Mine is a work most important, but not for talking of here, where danger waits close. Soon, I depart to seek fleas, my fellows, and join them."</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
Vog is first found in a camp located above the [[Putrified Ducts]]' [[Bellway]] station, which can be reached either by completing a platforming challenge involving [[Barnak|Barnaks]] or by using the [[Silk Soar]] ability, which is only available in [[Act 3]]. Vog is wary of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] and states that this cave is hers, fair fought and earned.<ref>Vog: <i>"Grrr.. bug not flea. Why you must bother me? This spot is mine, fair fought and earned."</i></ref><ref>Vog: <i>"You still here, bug not flea? Is rest I need before I leave for caravan. Not chat. You feel trouble-type. Make my shell tense."</i></ref>

After talking to her, she joins the [[Flea Caravan]]. Here Hornet learns Vog's task and suggests that she could send lost [[Flea]]s to the Caravan if she knew their locations.<ref>[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]: <i> "If you have sensed the locations of other lost fleas, share them with me. I may be able to send them safe to the caravan."</i></ref> However, Vog only reveals her knowledge in exchange for [[Rosaries]], believing that she has earned them through her work.<ref>Vog: <i> "My learnings? Not free for you, bug not flea. Rosaries! Give those and I shall say of what I have sensed. Work like mine... much long, and hard. For that, I deserve some riches held."</i></ref> After Hornet sends all lost Fleas to the Caravan, Vog changes her task to becoming their protector.<ref>Vog: <i> "You have brought them all, bug not flea. My work is done! No more searching needed. Ours is a caravan full! Now my duty must change. To watch. To protect. This new task I am looking much to liking."</i></ref>

In [[Act 3]], Vog humbly awaits the end of the world and believes that [[Flea]]s should be together to face it.<ref>Vog: <i> "So bug not flea, you return. World is ruined. Final end comes soon, says Fleamaster."</i></ref><ref>Vog: <i> "Much better it is now for fleas to be together, ready to face whatever end will come."</i></ref> During the <i>[[Ecstasy of the End]]</i> [[wish]], Vog leads the [[Festival of the Flea#Flea Dodge|Flea Dodge]] game. She is impressed by Hornet's skill if the latter manages to beat Vog's own score.<ref>Vog: <i> "Bug not flea... impressive was your performance. Your score exceeds even my own. To see skill so much, moments before everything ends, gives me unexpected joy. Rishkiz... I congratulate you, champion."</i></ref> Once Hornet becomes the Grand Champion, Vog addresses her by name for the first time.<ref>Vog: <i> "Grand Champion... bug called Hornet. Will you once again challenge the Flea Dodge trial?"</i></ref>

== Flea Findings ==
Once at the [[Flea Caravan]], Vog sells map pins revealing the locations of the [[Flea]]s that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has not found yet.

== Location ==
Vog is found in a hidden area directly above the [[Putrified Ducts]] [[Bellway]] station, accessed via the passage below the station. After talking to her, she makes her way to the [[Flea Caravan]]. The [[Flea Caravan]] can be found at either [[the Marrow]], [[Greymoor]], [[Blasted Steps]] or [[Fleatopia]], depending on the amount of Fleas found.
